title: Centres
subtitle: Where circles meet: address, city and an optional point on the map
country_immutable_hint: A centre cannot move to another country — one that changed country would be a different centre. Close it and open another.
coordinates_hint: Coordinates are optional, but latitude and longitude must be given together or left out together.
delete_message: “{{name}}” will be closed. It is not destroyed, and applications that froze its name keep it. A centre still holding circles cannot be closed.
error_name_long: The centre name is too long (255 characters maximum).
error_city_long: The city name is too long (255 characters maximum).
error_address_long: The address is too long (500 characters maximum).
error_coordinates_pair: Give latitude and longitude together, or leave both empty.
